abstract: We disprove a 1939 conjecture of Erd\H{o}s and Mahler by constructing, for every real $\tau\ge4$, a Cantor set of numbers of irrationality exponent $\tau$, each having infinitely many regular continued-fraction convergents of the form $2^a/3^b$.
hook: A 1939 Erdos-Mahler conjecture is false: counterexamples exist for every exponent 4 or above
hook_turn: exist for every exponent 4 or above
summary: Erdos and Mahler conjectured something about continued-fraction convergents of the form 2^a/3^b. The paper builds, for each irrationality exponent tau of at least 4, a Cantor set of numbers that have infinitely many such convergents, disproving it. The construction covers only exponents from 4 upward.
title: A counterexample to the Erd\H{o}s--Mahler conjecture
